h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karnal

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karnal

items.pText: Karnal is a prosperous agricultural city on the Grand Trunk Road in Haryana, known for its dairy and farm research institutes. Along with schools and colonies, we hear from families here who want a few pieces of play equipment for their own home garden or farmhouse. FunPlay Systems makes equipment for both at our factory in Vasai, about 1,220 km away, and sends it to Haryana by road.

A home playground is small, but the same rules apply as on a school ground. Each piece needs its safe play area, a cushioned surface and a firm foundation. Home buyers usually want a handful of pieces chosen for their own children's ages, with room to add more as the family grows. We can suggest a set that fits your lawn and send a simple layout before you order.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning play equipment for a home garden or farmhouse

c: Choose pieces for the ages of your children now and in two or three years. A toddler swing and a spring rider suit little ones, while a 5 ft slide, a climber and a standard swing suit children from about six. Place the play area where it can be seen from the house or verandah, and away from the driveway and any water tank. Haryana's winters are cold and its summers very hot, so give the corner some shade and check the bolts at each change of season.

items.q: Can families buy playground equipment for a home garden?
items.a: Yes. Families can order individual pieces for a home garden or farmhouse. Share the lawn size and your children's ages, and we will suggest a small set and a simple layout.

items.q: Do home playgrounds need rubber flooring?
items.a: Yes, under the safe play area of each piece. A lawn wears thin under swings and at slide exits, and rubber flooring gives a cushioned surface that stays even through the seasons.
Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Karnal and nearby towns in Haryana by road, and install it with our own team or a dealer in North India.
